title: Grunewald Tower
visualBrief: Red-brick memorial and observation tower on a raised porphyry terrace, with four open pointed memorial-hall arches, clustered corner turrets, pierced gallery rails, tapered inscribed shaft, corbelled upper viewing hall, four decorated gables and a course-built conical brick roof.

nativeAxes.front: +Z northeast Koenig Wilhelm entrance and three stair routes
nativeAxes.origin: Native+Z is the Koenig Wilhelm I entrance, northeast at heading2.185851134577897rad. Exact-Q833787 mapped terrace square supplies measured axes; inspected Commons gallery labels Berlin Grunewaldturm.JPG as east and Grunewaldturm Gesamtansicht.jpg as west. East photograph pairs the Koenig inscription/black eagle with central and side stairs; north-up satellite view locates those stairs on the northeast forecourt side. Native−Z faces southwest toward Havel/restaurant. Bearing follows the mapped edge; nominal east/west captions are directional descriptions, not due-east claims.

scaleBasis: Berlin’s official visitor and district records give a 55 m tower and 36 m viewing floor. The 1899 section supplies proportions, with a four-metre terrace confirmed by the contemporary Gartenlaube account. The mapped 26.068 × 26.045 m outline describes the broad terrace, not the slender shaft. Unreferenced catalog height 56 m is not used.

Static exterior and visible memorial hall using1899 architectural drawing,2007 mosaic,2008 east facade and2018 statue/portal details. Berlin official heights55m and36m observation floor,4m raised terrace. Original architectural master preserved; reviewed local master adds marble figure, four interior iron portraits, gold/blue eight-rib vault, opposite colored eagle shields, lower-turret foil recesses, paired back glazing, sparse photo-supported antenna equipment and two side flights; erroneous rear main staircase removed. Sculpture posture and broad relief/mosaic forms are medium-fi reconstructions, not measured likenesses or exact ornaments; inscriptions keep documented text through original line glyphs. Stair rises/runs, interior plinth/figure proportions, minor fittings and date-sensitive equipment remain photographic estimates. Hidden internal stair/rooms, detached restaurant, furniture/vegetation and current operations excluded. Terrain contact assumes locally level approach at lower stairs; host must fit terrain without embedding the4m platform. Exact mapped terrace controls position/orientation, not all exterior stair edges; footprint replacement is disabled.
